description: GrowPilot helps small businesses plan daily and weekly growth actions for Google Maps, Google Business Profile, reviews, social media, and customer follow-ups. It creates practical tasks, content ideas, review request messages, GBP post suggestions, WhatsApp follow-up drafts, and local visibility checklists so business owners know what to do next to improve their online presence.
